name: Brand24
oneLiner: AI social listening and media monitoring tool that tracks brand mentions across social media, news, blogs, forums, podcasts, video and review sites, with sentiment analysis and AI-visibility tracking.
bestFor: Marketing teams and multi-location brands that want to catch online conversations and PR spikes early; it monitors mentions but is not a review-response tool.

updates.text: Brand24 added an LLM Monitoring tab to its panel, integrating its Chatbeat tool to show how ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude describe and rank a brand (Brand Score, median position, AI share of voice, citing sources). Changelog entry is marked 'Dec' without a year; the LLM Listening blog post was updated January 13, 2026.

Brand24 launched an official ChatGPT app and an MCP server so users can query their mentions, sentiment, influencers and competitor data from ChatGPT, Claude and other AI assistants (exact launch month not confirmed).

features: Mention tracking across social media, news sites, blogs, forums, podcasts, newsletters, video and review sites
AI sentiment analysis of mentions (positive, negative, neutral) and emotion analysis
Discussion volume and reach charts with alerts to spot spikes and potential PR crises early
Brand Assistant: a chat interface for asking questions about your mention data
AI visibility / LLM monitoring of how AI assistants mention and rank your brand (add-on on most plans)
ChatGPT app and MCP server for querying data from AI assistants

pricing.text: Five published plans: Individual $249/month ($199/month billed annually; 1 user, 3 keywords, 2K mentions a month, updates every 12 hours), Team $349 ($299; 7 keywords, 10K mentions, hourly updates), Pro $499 ($399; 12 keywords, 40K mentions, real time), Business $699 ($599; 25 keywords, 100K mentions, real time), Enterprise from $1,499/month billed annually. 14-day free trial, no credit card; no free plan. API access $149 extra; AI Visibility marked as an add-on except on Enterprise; mentions over the limit incur overage fees.

notes: Prices confirmed on brand24.com/prices (fetched 2026-11). Dropped from the current review: old prices (Individual $79, Team $149, Pro $199, Enterprise $399 and the four-tier structure), '4,000 customers' (Brand24's own pages give inconsistent counts: 2400+, 4000+, 'thousands'), and Samsung, Wondery and Stanford as named customers (Samsung appears only as a monitored brand in a public Brand24 tool; Wondery/Stanford not confirmed). 'Proprietary Presence Score' not re-verified. AI Visibility is marked as an add-on in the vendor's feature table and included in the Enterprise plan list (the page is not fully consistent). G2 review count varies between G2 pages (about 330 to 355); 332 is the profile figure. Founded 2011 in Poland not re-verified. Still fits as a listening tool, but it is not a review management platform.
pros: Covers social media, news, blogs, forums, podcasts, newsletters, video and review sites in one feed
AI sentiment and emotion analysis on every mention
Real-time updates on Pro, Business and Enterprise; hourly on Team
LLM Monitoring shows how ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude describe and rank a brand
14-day free trial with no credit card

cons.text: No free plan; after the 14-day trial, plans start at $199 per month billed annually ($249 billed monthly)
The Individual plan has 1 user and 3 keywords and updates about every 12 hours
The AI Visibility module is marked as an add-on except on Enterprise, and API access costs $149 extra
Monitors mentions but has no review-response workflow, so restaurants need a separate tool to reply to reviews
Mentions over a plan's monthly limit incur overage fees
